newsitem.title: GREECE: GREECE RAISES 208BLN DRS FROM T-BILLS, 2-YR ZEROS.
newsitem.headline: GREECE RAISES 208BLN DRS FROM T-BILLS, 2-YR ZEROS.

text.p: Greece raised a total of 208 billion drachmas from the sale of 12-month T-bills and two-year zeros on Tuesday according to provisional figures, the finance ministry said in a statement.
The total amount will be finalised on Wednesday, it added.

Public subscriptions for 12-month T-bills, featuring a gross rate of 9.6 percent reached 103 billion drachmas and subscriptions for two-year zeros, offering an annual average yield of 9.5 percent, stood at 105 billion, it added.
"These issues exceeded maturities of 173 billion drachmas on July 1," it said.

Sales of two-year zeros since the begining of the year have covered 80 percent of the ministry's annual target of 2.0 trillion drachmas, it said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
